lost.title: Lost connection to ReactCraft
lost.body: Trying to reconnect. You can keep editing once the connection is back.

welcome.title: Welcome to ReactCraft
welcome.subtitle: This folder has no workspace yet. Create one to start designing.
welcome.storage: The design is saved as JSON files in the .reactcraft/ folder right here. You can commit it to Git with your source code.

form.name: Workspace name
form.mode: Which screen do you design for first?
form.desktopFirstHelp: Design for large screens, then adjust for tablets and phones.
form.mobileFirstHelp: Design for phones, then expand to larger screens.
form.localeHelp: Language of the website you design: used for sample data and for number, currency and date formats. Separate from the Studio interface language.

errors.name: Name the workspace, up to 64 characters.
errors.frameSize: Frames are 320 to 3840 px wide and 320 to 2160 px high.

workspaceError.title: Cannot open the workspace
workspaceError.intro: Some workspace files are broken. ReactCraft does not open a workspace in part, so nothing is overwritten and lost. Restore from a backup, or fix the file by hand and press Try again.
workspaceError.noBackup: This file has no backup yet. Fix it by hand.

editor.toggleLeft: Show or hide the left panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.toggleRight: Show or hide the right panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.libraryLater: The library of elements to drag onto the page comes with drag and drop.
editor.selectHint: Select an element in Layers to see its properties.

narrow.title: The Studio needs a screen at least 1024 px wide
narrow.body: Open it on a computer or widen the browser window. Your design keeps being saved.

notice.E017: The design changed elsewhere, so it was reloaded. Undo history was cleared.
notice.E005: The server refused the last change, so the design was reloaded. Undo history was cleared.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Changes at once, without reloading. Remembered for every workspace on this computer.
settings.exportLater: Applies once code export is available (Phase 3).
settings.typecheckHelp: Finds type errors in the exported code before you run the project. Turn off to export a few seconds faster.
settings.buildCheckHelp: Runs the project build to make sure it still builds. The build runs the project's own configuration and plugins, so turn it on only for projects you trust.

trust.bar: This workspace is not trusted: backend scanning, code export and AI are locked. You can still view and edit the design.
trust.title: Do you trust this workspace?
trust.intro: This workspace is not trusted on this computer yet. When you scan a backend or export code, ReactCraft reads and writes the folders below.
trust.restricted: Until you trust it, you can view and edit the design; backend scanning, code export, test builds and sending source code to AI are locked.
trust.later: Not now, only view and edit the design
trust.noLinks: This workspace points to no other folder.
trust.outside: Outside the workspace folder: make sure you know this folder.

overlay.textHasFormat: Formatted content will be editable in rich text

validation.pxRange: Valid px value from 0 to 10000, max 2 decimal places
validation.opacityRange: Valid opacity from 0 to 100, multiple of 5
